scripts.build: vite build apps/web && esbuild apps/server/src/api.ts apps/server/src/worker.ts apps/server/src/goal-setup-map.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outdir=apps/server/dist
scripts.types: tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p tools
scripts.check: pnpm types && prettier --check . && pnpm lint && pnpm infra && pnpm build && node tools/check-goal-setup-map.ts && pnpm test && playwright test
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings . && node tools/source-rules.ts && depcruise apps packages && knip --include dependencies,unlisted && node tools/check-rules.ts
scripts.infra: docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/repo:ro" -w /repo rhysd/actionlint:1.7.7 && docker run --rm -i hadolint/hadolint:v2.14.0-alpine < Dockerfile
